parts.t: One guide for each South Surrey and White Rock MLS® sub-area I work in. Each covers schools, parks, planning and what to check before you buy, with a source next to every fact.
South Surrey is one of the six communities that make up the City of Surrey. The guides follow MLS® sub-area names, which are not City boundaries.

blocks.text: South Surrey and White Rock guide questions

parts.t: Which South Surrey and White Rock areas have a guide?

Nine: Crescent Bch Ocean Pk. (Crescent Beach and Ocean Park), Elgin Chantrell, Grandview Surrey (Grandview Heights), Hazelmere, King George Corridor, Morgan Creek, Pacific Douglas, Sunnyside Park Surrey and White Rock. Each follows its MLS® sub-area name.
Is White Rock part of Surrey?
No. White Rock has been its own city since 1957, with its own council and zoning bylaw, so
rules apply there. Its public schools are run by Surrey Schools (SD36). The other eight areas are in the
Is Grandview Heights the same as Grandview Surrey?
Mostly. Grandview Surrey is the MLS® sub-area name, and Grandview Heights is the name most people use. Listings in the Grandview Surrey sub-area also take in some streets north of 28 Avenue. See the
Do these areas have official boundaries?
Most are MLS® sub-area names, not City boundaries.

Hazelmere and Elgin Chantrell both include farmland in the Agricultural Land Reserve, and the Douglas plan area is bordered by the ALR to the north. ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the
How do I check the school for an address?
. It covers White Rock too. Catchments can be split, so check the exact address.
